attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Carlsbad: Surfing the Waves of Medicine
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE closes its 2027 in-person season in Carlsbad, California, from November 8 to 10, 2027, at the Westin Carlsbad. The program offers current updates and clinical pearls for advanced practice providers, with 18+ CE/CME credits listed by NPACE. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,050; staying three or more nights at the conference hotel takes $100 off, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.
